resume.summary: Data Engineer and Business Intelligence professional with 6+ years of experience designing data warehouses, developing ETL/ELT pipelines, implementing data governance initiatives, and delivering enterprise analytics solutions.

descriptions: Supported the implementation of enterprise-wide Data Governance and Customer 360 initiatives, improving customer master data quality and reducing duplicate records by 20%.
Led the design of conceptual, logical, and physical data models to enable unified customer analytics capabilities.
Standardized ETL/ELT pipelines, data definitions, and transformation logic to improve scalability, maintainability, and governance compliance.
Designed and implemented a centralized data warehouse capturing over 90% of organizational project management data.
Optimized Power BI datasets and refresh processes, reducing refresh times from 4 hours to 5 minutes.
Delivered dashboards and reports covering approximately 80% of business reporting requirements.
Designed and developed the organization's internal data warehouse to support analytics and reporting initiatives.
Established foundational data structures and ETL processes for scalable reporting.
Implemented an AML sanction screening platform achieving approximately 85% screening effectiveness.
Developed automated workflows that reduced tardiness memo processing from 3 days to 10 minutes.
Built and optimized ETL pipelines that reduced report delivery times from 2-3 hours to under 5 minutes.
Led performance enhancements for a patient blood pressure registry, improving application responsiveness by 10%.
Delivered technical training and system onboarding to 37 Rural Health Units across three provinces.
Developed Python automation tools integrating web scraping and APIs to streamline business processes.
Automated e-commerce account provisioning workflows, reducing manual effort by 40%.
